items.title: Stop Making Chicken the Old Way! Try This Instead!  Oven-Baked Chicken Legs with Potatoes 🍗 Ingredients: * 6–7 chicken leg quarters * 2–3 lbs potatoes * 4–5 garlic cloves, minced * 3–4 tbsp olive oil * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp chicken seasoning * ½ tsp ground coriander Instructions: 1. Cut each chicken leg into two pieces and make a few small slits in the meat. 2. In a large bowl, combine salt, black pepper, paprika, chicken seasoning, ground coriander, minced garlic, and olive oil. Mix well. 3. Add the chicken and coat each piece thoroughly with the seasoning mixture. Let marinate for 30–60 minutes. 4. Peel the potatoes and cut them into bite-sized pieces. Place them on a baking tray. Add salt, paprika, ground coriander, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated. 5. Arrange the marinated chicken pieces on top of the potatoes. 6. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Bake for 50–60 minutes, until the chicken is fully cooked, golden brown, and the potatoes are tender. Enjoy this delicious, juicy chicken with perfectly seasoned roasted potatoes! #F#FamilyDinnerC#ChickenRecipesE#EasyRecipesF#FoodTokDinnerIdeas
